title: OAI cartilage morphology and fixed-location radiographic joint-space width
population: Women; one right-first fixed knee per participant before endpoint/C completeness; baseline MRI09B project subset
Y: V00JSW225: baseline medial radiographic joint-space width at fixed location x=0.225 (mm)

C_preprocessing.V00XRSCFL: Adjacent native grades 2/3 combined; retain three classes; original grades preserved
C_preprocessing.others: Observed native grades retained; no continuous variable discretization

measurement_units: Y/U mm; age years; BMI kg/m^2; height mm
measurement_definition: U MFTC.ThCtAB = MT.ThCtAB + cMF.ThCtAB, MRI09B DESS 75% femoral ROI; Y fixed-location Xray JSW, project16; ordinal Xray project15
interpretation: Cross-modality structural assessment of joint-space preservation and cartilage morphology; distinct contemporaneous Y/U
scientific_question: Can native ordinal structural signs support prediction of quantitative joint-space width through partially observed quantitative MRI cartilage morphology?
limitations: Exploratory selected imaging subset, complete-case women, unweighted. Y and U remain closely related structural constructs. Correlated C/shared Xray reading errors and possible C-Y associations beyond U require scrutiny. Cross-sectional prediction is not causal or knee-replacement prediction.
test_U_design: Fixed C1/C2-proportional random revelation; nested 20/50; shared by all CC methods
